# Generated by mods/cm_maps/tools/port_from_cm.py - do not edit by hand.
# Lifted from Construction Manager dev, cm_hidden_window_scripted_gui.txt.
# Renamed cm_ -> bcm_ and nothing else; rebuild after a CM update.
#
# Only the blocks this mod's maps reach: bcm_pf_river_should_process, bcm_pf_river_record, bcm_pf_river_fill_batch


# Root is the player. Gates the hidden window's river-adjacency precompute driver while it runs.
bcm_pf_river_should_process = {
	is_shown = {
		is_host = yes
		has_global_variable = bcm_pf_river_process
	}
}

# Root is the player. Adds a real river-connected neighbor to the source's bcm_pf_river_neighbors list,
# read per edge by the placement finder path search to gate the river channel.
bcm_pf_river_record = {
	saved_scopes = { bcm_pf_river_src bcm_pf_river_nb }
	effect = {
		scope:bcm_pf_river_src = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bcm_pf_river_neighbors target = scope:bcm_pf_river_nb }
		}
	}
}

# Root is the player. Advances the batched river harvest one tick: queues the next batch of source
# locations for the datamodel to instantiate, or, once every location has been queued, stamps the
# harvest complete, tears down the source lists (freeing the per-frame widget cost) and invalidates
# the finder scores computed before the adjacency data existed. The harvest runs once per save, so
# nothing synchronous is chained off it here. 150 sources per tick keeps the record volume under
# the flood threshold. An iterator limit cannot bound the cursor walk: the limit is evaluated
# against local_var:bcm_pf_river_i before the body increments it, so every element passes and the
# whole tail of the list is queued in one fire, flooding scripted_gui_command until the game hangs.
bcm_pf_river_fill_batch = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bcm_pf_river_idx < global_var:bcm_pf_river_count }
			clear_global_variable_list = bcm_pf_river_batch
			set_local_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_hi value = { value = global_var:bcm_pf_river_idx add = 150 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_i value = 0 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bcm_pf_river_locations
				if = {
					limit = {
						local_var:bcm_pf_river_i >= global_var:bcm_pf_river_idx
						local_var:bcm_pf_river_i < local_var:bcm_pf_river_hi
					}
					add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bcm_pf_river_batch target = this }
				}
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_i add = 1 }
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_idx add = 150 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bcm_pf_river_process }
			clear_global_variable_list = bcm_pf_river_locations
			clear_global_variable_list = bcm_pf_river_batch
			set_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_idx value = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_count value = 0 }
			remove_global_variable = bcm_pf_river_process
			# Written only here, so a save taken mid-harvest carries no stamp and re-harvests.
			set_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_stamp value = bcm_pf_river_version_value }
			if = {
				# A mode opened during the harvest primed its edges before the neighbors existed;
				# re-priming lets its own driver rebatch instead of caching that for four years.
				limit = { exists = var:bcm_pf_mode_open }
				bcm_pf_force_refresh = yes
			}
			else = {
				remove_variable = bcm_pf_fresh_g
				remove_variable = bcm_pf_fresh_c
			}
		}
	}
}
